entities.name: Brigid Baeli
entities.description: An elderly kithkin archer of Kinsbaile, the Hero of Kinsbaile and right-hand of Gaddock Teeg, who carries her Lorwyn self through the Great Aurora and later helps stranded Strixhaven students.

entities.name: Shadowmoor Brigid Baeli
entities.description: Brigid's Shadowmoor incarnation, distrusting and curt but never maliciously cruel, with no memory of her adventures with Maralen and Ashling.

entities.name: Gaddock Teeg
entities.description: The kithkin leader of Kinsbaile whom Brigid served; he orders her to capture Rhys and dies when Colfenor combusts.

entities.name: Ashling
entities.description: A flamekin messenger sent to find Rhys, whom Brigid nearly drowns under Colfenor's manipulation.

entities.name: Ashling the Destroyer
entities.description: A destructive elemental-fire form of Ashling who attacks Mistmeadow and remembers Brigid's actions toward her.

entities.name: Rhys
entities.description: A Gilt-Leaf elf outcast who kills Taercenn Nath, is later bound to Maralen by a pact, and fades away into daylight.

entities.name: Maralen
entities.description: A wayward elf and Oona's daughter-creation who takes Oona's role as queen of the fae, betrays Brigid, and keeps her friendship over the years.

entities.name: Colfenor
entities.description: A treefolk, Rhys's former mentor, who manipulates Teeg's message and combusts in a rebirth as a sapling.

entities.name: Taercenn Nath
entities.description: The Gilt-Leaf elvish commander who occupies Kinsbaile and is killed by Rhys.

entities.name: Sygg
entities.description: A merrow ferrymaster who later captains a pirate crew with Brigid and holds the Crescent of Morningtide.

entities.name: Brion
entities.description: A giant who camps near Kinsbaile with his sibling Kiel to collect stories.

entities.name: Kiel
entities.description: A giant who camps near Kinsbaile with his sibling Brion.

entities.name: Jack Chierdagh
entities.description: A kithkin scout on a mission to get Rosheen's scroll, whom Brigid saves and helps become the Hero of Mistmeadow.

entities.name: Wryget
entities.description: A merrow member of Sygg's crew who survives and works as Brigid's partner.

entities.name: Wryllick
entities.description: A merrow crew member killed by Jack in self-defense.

entities.name: Wrybert
entities.description: A merrow crew member killed by Sygg.

entities.name: Rosheen
entities.description: An elemental whose scroll Jack seeks and whose path changes when the Vendilion sisters take it.

entities.name: Vigilant Eidren
entities.description: A defender of Mistmeadow whose sacrifice hurls Ashling the Destroyer away.

entities.name: Oona
entities.description: The queen of the fae who is Maralen's mother-creator.

entities.name: Oko
entities.description: A mischievous faerie, Oona's precursor to Maralen, who brings Isilu to Goldmeadow.

entities.name: Isilu
entities.description: The living embodiment of Shadowmoor's darkness, whose footfalls turn Goldmeadow into Mistmeadow.

entities.name: Eirdu
entities.description: Lorwyn's incarnation, who restores Mistmeadow to Goldmeadow.

entities.name: Abigale
entities.description: A Strixhaven student stranded on Lorwyn.

entities.name: Tamira
entities.description: A Strixhaven student stranded on Lorwyn.

entities.name: Kirol
entities.description: A Strixhaven student stranded on Lorwyn.

entities.name: Sanar
entities.description: A Strixhaven student stranded on Lorwyn.

entities.name: Kinsbaile
entities.description: The kithkin clachan that is Brigid's home and site of the Festival of Tales.

entities.name: Goldmeadow
entities.description: A kithkin clachan where Brigid trains the city watch; it becomes Mistmeadow under Isilu's darkness.

entities.name: Murmuring Bosk
entities.description: A place where Rhys plants a seedcone and where Brigid attacks Ashling.

entities.name: Cayr Ulios
entities.description: The faerie court above which Maralen betrays Brigid.

entities.name: Lorwyn
entities.description: The plane of dual aspects, Lorwyn by day and Shadowmoor by night.

entities.name: Arcavios
entities.description: The plane the stranded students come from.

entities.name: Great Aurora
entities.description: The event that shifts Lorwyn into Shadowmoor and changes its inhabitants.

entities.name: Phyrexian invasion
entities.description: The invasion that later disrupts Lorwyn's balance, making the Aurora run wild and Omenpaths open.

entities.name: Crescent of Morningtide
entities.description: Sygg's heirloom that lets Brigid survive the change to Shadowmoor intact and use shapewater magic.

entities.name: Source of the Wanderwine
aliases: The Source of the Wanderwine River
entities.description: An elemental power of water that Brigid and Maralen force to help them.

entities.name: Vendilion clique
entities.description: A faerie clique that dogs Ashling and Brigid.

entities.name: Festival of Tales
entities.description: Kinsbaile's annual festival, during which Brigid leaves her home.

events.summary: Gaddock Teeg assigns Brigid to accompany Ashling in finding the Gilt-Leaf elf Rhys.
events.quote: Brigid became embroiled in an increasingly complex adventure when Gaddock Teeg assigned her to accompany a flamekin messenger named Ashling on her mission to find a Gilt-Leaf elf named Rhys .

events.summary: Teeg orders Brigid to capture Rhys as a gift for the Gilt-Leaf commander Nath.
events.quote: Teeg ordered Brigid to capture Rhys and bring him back as a gift to Nath.

events.summary: Manipulated by Colfenor's message, Brigid nearly drowns Ashling and attacks Rhys at the Murmuring Bosk.
events.quote: Brigid nearly drowned Ashling on the banks of the Murmuring Bosk to snuff out her fire, attacked Rhys, and escaped to Kinsbaile with an unconscious, dying Ashling in tow.

events.summary: Rhys kills Nath, ending the elvish threat, and Colfenor admits he ordered Brigid's attack to coincide with his rebirth.
events.quote: the elvish threat to Kinsbaile was negated when Rhys killed Taercenn Nath in hand-to-hand combat

events.summary: Filled with self-reproach, Brigid leaves Kinsbaile during the Festival of Tales to atone.
events.quote: Brigid wanted to atone for her actions and saw the opportunity to leave her life in Kinsbaile behind.

events.summary: Teeg dies in flames as Colfenor combusts, though Ashling is saved.
events.quote: as he would eventually be set ablaze and die as Colfenor dramatically combusted by way of his own machinations.

events.summary: Brigid works as a decoy to free Brion and Kiel from Gilt-Leaf hunters.
events.quote: She worked as a decoy to aid the liberation of Brion and Kiel from the Gilt-Leaf hunters that had captured them when they laid siege to Kinsbaile

events.summary: Holding Sygg's Crescent, Brigid meets the Source of the Wanderwine and survives the shift into Shadowmoor intact.
events.quote: which enabled her to survive the change between Lorwyn to Shadowmoor with her memories, abilities, and physical image intact.

events.summary: Brigid knocks Sygg out to save Jack's life.
events.quote: When Sygg wanted to kill Jack, Brigid knocked him out to save Jack's life.

events.summary: Brigid gives Jack her magical wingbow.
events.quote: She gave Jack her magical wingbow, capable of flight.

events.summary: Brigid lives in Mistmeadow and helps defend it from Ashling the Destroyer.
events.quote: Later, Brigid came to live in Mistmeadow and helped to defend the city from Ashling the Destroyer.

events.summary: Vigilant Eidren sacrifices himself to hurl Ashling away and save Mistmeadow.
events.quote: Mistmeadow was saved only by the sacrifice of Vigilant Eidren, who channeled the power of the Wilt-Leaf forest through his body directly at Ashling and hurled her away.

events.summary: Maralen takes Ashling's elemental power, then betrays Brigid above Cayr Ulios.
events.quote: Maralen snapped the Crescent from Brigid's neck and sent her falling.

events.summary: Maralen takes over the role of Queen of the Fae and restores the day/night cycle.
events.quote: Maralen had taken over the role of the Queen of Fae and restored the normal day/night cycle.

events.summary: Years after the Phyrexian invasion, Brigid finds four stranded Arcavios students and leads them to Goldmeadow.
events.quote: she found four students from the plane of Arcavios , Abigale , Tamira , Kirol , and Sanar , who had been stranded by an instanced Omenpath.

events.summary: Oko brings Isilu to Goldmeadow; the town becomes Mistmeadow and Brigid becomes her Shadowmoor self.
events.quote: for the first time in her long and storied life, Brigid became her Shadowmoor self.

events.summary: Eirdu restores Mistmeadow to Goldmeadow and the kithkin to themselves.
events.quote: another student returned, bringing Lorwyn's incarnation, Eirdu , which restored Mistmeadow to Goldmeadow and the kithkin to their former selves.

events.summary: Rhys is freed from his pact with Maralen and fades away into the daylight.
events.quote: then watched as Rhys was freed from the magical pact he had forged with Maralen decades ago and faded away into the daylight.
